description: The exception regime (D-260): the recorded state in which every lock of the engine lifts except the kept ones (money, other people).

regime.exception_active.description: True while the exception regime holds: every lock lifts except regime.exception_kept. The default is true for the grant of 01/11 10:52 BRT (D-260, commit 9c41dc836, granted by Daniel); the shared store holds the same grant. Only the person who holds the order writes it (scripts/config set).

regime.exception_exit.default: GitHub writes no longer limit the flow
regime.exception_exit.description: The condition that ends the regime.

regime.exception_kept.description: The locks that never lift, whatever the regime: money and other people (D-260).

regime.exception_reason.default: GitHub secondary rate limit refuses writes and the flow stops; Daniel: in exception every lock lifts except money and other people
regime.exception_reason.description: The break that caused the regime.
